Mira H: Quick sync — Tribeca LLM Salon booth ops. Load-in Fri morning, booth #B4. Need final kit list + arrival plan by Tue EOD. @Sabine L can you confirm print ETA?
Sabine L: Printing is green, proofs done. Estimated arrival at office Wed AM. Will need final copy for one-pagers by Tue noon.
Jon R: Re: swag — we have 250 enamel pins, 300 silicone phone stands, 400 stickers, 100 sample prompt cards. Do we want socks? budget check.
Mira H: Love the pins. Socks are cool but over budget unless we cut stands. Thoughts?
Liam S: Ops note — electrical at venue limited. We'll bring two 6-outlet UPS + 1 power strip per demo. Someone needs to coordinate AV at load-in.
Sabine L: Can someone proof the one-pager? I've left a Google draft with sections: what we do, latency/cost bullets, sign-up CTA, demo QR.
Jon R: I'll do a quick pass tonight. Also propose color-coded lanyards: blue = sales demo, green = self-serve, yellow = partner ops. Makes routing easier.
Mira H: Good call on lanyards. Also want a 5-min lightning slot each hour for quick demos. Need 2 volunteers per slot.
marketing-bot: Reminder: speaker-submissions cutoff in 48 hours — https://tribeca.example/speakers 
Sabine L: Shipping label for the kit is created. Carrier: FastShip. AWB: FS123456789US. ETA to venue Fri 08:30. Packing list below:
```
- Booth backdrop (x1)
- Demo laptop + charger (x2)
- UPS units (x2)
- Enamel pins (x250)
- Phone stands (x300)
- Stickers (x400)
- One-pagers (x300)
- Prompt cards (x100)
- Lanyards (x350)
- Tool kit + gaffer tape
```
Mira H: Perfect. @Jon R can you confirm volunteer roster by Wed? Also add a QR sheet for our lead Airtable form with UTM param 'tribeca-2026'.
Jon R: Yep — I'll ping the on-call events list and lock volunteers tonight. Airtable form link updated. Prefill param set to tribeca-2026.
Liam S: One more ops ask — where do we store demo KV caches overnight? If we use the hotel backroom we need to label the SSDs and keep a second encrypted copy.
Mira H: Good catch. We'll pack two encrypted SSDs, label W1/W2, store W2 with Sabine in the office. Add that to packing checklist.
Sabine L: Added. Also ordered a small branded tote for 200 attendees as a giveaway (order #BT200-TR). ETA Thu.
Jon R: Final checklist reminders for load-in:
- Check AV with venue rep (09:00)
- Drop shipping crates at door (09:15)
- Setup backdrop + table layout (09:30)
- Power test + wifi check (09:45)
- Volunteer briefing (10:00)
Mira H: Awesome. If anyone has final copy changes to one-pager post 11:59pm Mon, I'll do a single pass Tue AM. Otherwise we lock. :thumbsup:
